changeSet.author: snapdragon
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO games (id, name, description, slug, sort_order, created_at) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM games), 'Tron', 'Two-player light-cycles. Outlast your opponent without crashing into a trail.', 'tron', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM games), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games WHERE slug = 'tron'); INSERT INTO chapters (name, description, slug, scene_type, sort_order, asset_url, scene_config, game_id, created_at) SELECT 'Tron', 'Two light-cycles leave solid trails. Steer to survive; do not crash.', 'tron', 'tron', 1, '/api/assets/levels/tron/index.html', '{}', (SELECT id FROM games WHERE slug = 'tron'), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters WHERE slug = 'tron');
